name: Souma Arata
source:
A second-year student. For his parent's convenience, he returned to the town where his sister lives. There he is reunited with her and his old friends, and attends school with them. He's a pretty friendly and normal young man.

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=724789]Getchu[/url]]
